    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    VECTOR is built on the conviction that engineering fluency is a strategic capability — not a technical footnote. Every module pairs business-English precision with technical judgment, systems literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium engineering leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern engineering — from the foundations of structural design and safety standards to AI-powered engineering and smart infrastructure.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — project reviews, client communication, safety audits, technology adoption — written for international engineering professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. VECTOR reflects his vision: engineering fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and technical credibility.

    Designed for the engineers, technical leads, and project managers shaping how the world gets built — VECTOR is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for turning ideas into working reality.
